# Effectiveness benchmark

Generated 2026-11-22 15:50:34 from `reports/effectiveness_watson.jsonl` — 252 evaluation rows over 3 series, horizons 21, 63, 126. Protocol: `docs/09_benchmark.md`.

Rows are **zero-shot** (no adaptation) and slide windows over the span(s) named above — for zero-shot rows the whole series is legitimate because the model saw no training data; an *adapted* checkpoint must be scored with `--spans test`, or the comparison leaks. Same horizon grid, same window count, same seed for every model. Rows carry the **registry key the sweep requested** (adapters may report a family-level key internally). `ctx` is the context actually used (an oversized one is clamped to the span, which is recorded, not hidden). **CRPS/WQL/pinball appear only for models that emit quantiles**; a point-only model gets point metrics and is marked `pt` — a probabilistic column with a dash is not a zero. `skill` is `1 − MASE` (MASE normalises by the in-sample mean |Δ| of the train span), so MASE is the column to read and a negative skill means the model lost to that trivial scaler on this series.
